sentence: This project uses machine learning on head CT scans to predict outcomes for patients with intracerebral hemorrhage.
This project tries to find out how cholesterol biosynthesis affects endometrial cancer metastasis and recurrence, using an animal model.
This project studies why supporting cells in the cochlea of adult mice do not divide again and regrow hair cells.
This project studies many genes in vascular cells to find which gene programs influence the risk of vascular diseases of the heart and lung.
This project studies the structure of how antibodies attach to HIV and how that blocks membrane fusion.
This project builds a 3D bioprinter that uses acoustics to print functional tissues with high resolution and high cell densities.
This project looks for biomarker signatures of infection in young children with and without HIV to guide preventive therapy.
This project studies how cancer survivors cope with psychological distress and how their coping strategies affect that distress.
This project builds an ultrasound imaging system that uses volume sweep imaging and artificial intelligence to assess palpable breast abnormalities.
This project replaces a failed microscope system so that work using high resolution confocal microscopy can continue.
This project uses a mouse-adapted pegivirus to study how the virus avoids the immune system and stays at high levels in the blood.
This project tests whether imaging with a tumor-specific radiopharmaceutical can improve diagnosis in patients with head and neck cancer.
This project builds simulation software and methods to estimate indirect genetic effects and the impact of assortative mating.
This project provides advanced instruments and expertise to support biomedical research.
This project studies signals that control epigenetic programs in exhausted T cells and tries to switch them back to a working state.
This project runs laboratory studies connected to clinical research on HIV, tuberculosis and Hepatitis B infections.
This project collects, processes and stores blood and bone marrow samples from patients with hematologic diseases and shares them with researchers.
